```yaml
name: Dev Canary Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: pytest

  deploy_modal:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Modal CLI
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://modal.com/install.sh | bash
          echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Deploy Modal
        env:
          MODAL_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.MODAL_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          modal deploy distributed/deploy/modal_app.py
          # Capture the deployed URL (replace with actual output parsing)
          echo "APP_URL=https://your-modal-app-url" >> $GITHUB_ENV
      - name: Verify /health
        run: |
          curl -f https://$APP_URL/health || exit 1

  deploy_railway:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Railway CLI
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://railway.app/install.sh | bash
          echo "$HOME/.railway/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Deploy Railway
        env:
          RAILWAY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RAILWAY_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          railway login --token $RAILWAY_TOKEN
          railway init
          railway up
          # Capture the deployed URL (replace with actual output parsing)
          echo "APP_URL=https://your-railway-app-url" >> $GITHUB_ENV
      - name: Verify /health
        run: |
          curl -f https://$APP_URL/health || exit 1

  deploy_fly:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Flyctl
        run: |
          curl -L https://fly.io/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.fly" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Deploy Fly
        env:
          FLY_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FLY_API_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          flyctl auth login --access-token $FLY_API_TOKEN
          bash distributed/deploy/fly-deploy.sh
          # Capture the deployed URL (replace with actual output parsing)
          echo "APP_URL=https://your-fly-app-url" >> $GITHUB_ENV
      - name: Verify /health
        run: |
          curl -f https://$APP_URL/health || exit 1

  deploy_render:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Deploy Render
        env:
          RENDER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.RENDER_API_KEY }}
          RENDER_SERVICE_ID: ${{ secrets.RENDER_SERVICE_ID }}
        run: |
          curl -X POST https://api.render.com/v1/services/$RENDER_SERVICE_ID/deploys \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $RENDER_API_KEY" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"branch":"main"}'
          # Capture the deployed URL (replace with actual output parsing)
          echo "APP_URL=https://your-render-app-url" >> $GITHUB_ENV
      - name: Verify /health
        run: |
          curl -f https://$APP_URL/health || exit 1

  deploy_daytona:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Daytona CLI
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/releases/latest/download/daytona-linux-amd64.tar.gz | tar -xz -C /usr/local/bin
      - name: Deploy Daytona
        env:
          DAYTONA_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DAYTONA_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          daytona login --token $DAYTONA_TOKEN
          daytona create
          # Capture the deployed URL (replace with actual output parsing)
          echo "APP_URL=https://your-daytona-app-url" >> $GITHUB_ENV
      - name: Verify /health
        run: |
          curl -f https://$APP_URL/health || exit 1
```
